text: ここから　すごく　とおいけど　グレン　タウンに　ポケモン　けんきゅうじょが　ある　カセキを　よみがえらせる　けんきゅうも　してる　らしいぜ

structure.jp: ここから　すごく　とおいけど
structure.en: it's really far from here, but

structure.jp: グレン　タウンに　ポケモン　けんきゅうじょが　ある
structure.en: there's a Pokémon Lab on Cinnabar Island

structure.jp: カセキを　よみがえらせる　けんきゅうも
structure.en: research on bringing fossils back to life too

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい after a plain form says this is what you have heard, not something you know for sure. してる　らしい = 'apparently they're doing it'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.span: よみがえらせる　けんきゅう
patterns.explanation: This verb shape says you make something do it: よみがえる 'come back to life' becomes よみがえらせる. Placed before けんきゅう it describes the research. カセキを　よみがえらせる　けんきゅう = 'research on bringing fossils back to life'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts with 'but', often just to set the scene. とおいけど = 'it's far, but'.
